propositions: Plan reviews must track distinct execution and planning phases in compiled state; winning STATUS entry to in_progress sets execution, open sets planning, others preserve current phase, and losing fork events never update it.

Manifest emission must include review-phase and for execution-only a fixed 0.80 priority-floor in exact order after advisory, parsed through validate_review_phase_metadata with strict grammar and cardinality rules.

Phase compatibility validation must compare signed phase/floor against current compiled phase with three outcomes: compatible (planning accepts all, execution accepts execution floor >= 0.80), incompatible (planning rejects execution, execution rejects low floor), and malformed (syntax/type errors).

Plan review signing must capture one immutable pre-LLM generation (phase, priority_floor, own_material, relation_snapshot, ticket_store_revision); retries may revalidate HEAD up to three times but never alter the baseline; terminal stale generation returns unsigned without writing.

Pre-feature snapshots without plan_review_phase must bootstrap once per reducer-cache version increment from compiled status (open/idea→planning, other known→execution); legacy v2 sidecar fields omit priority_floor for planning and require 0.80 floor for execution.
